patch.value: Resumable since delta packs with substantive messages and claims

Add context-pack since with opaque retained-history cursors, bounded substantive comment and handoff excerpts, ranked changes and claims, strict output budget and omission receipts; measure against the core activity retry and comment-read route on a public tracker copy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked: core context --for handoff is a current-state snapshot, activity digest/compact omits patch comment text, and pm-brief brief since already classifies lifecycle, priority and dependency changes but has no durable cursor, substantive comment excerpts or claim continuation. Implement only the missing resumable delta serving surface over SDK activity plus the existing certified complete item reader. Keep tracker/history semantics in the SDK. Plan non-git/no-git-PATH regressions, behavioural revert proof and public-copy three-call completeness/token comparison.
